metadata.description: Production-readiness and store-release audits for Flutter apps

plugins.name: flutter-store-ready
plugins.description: Store-release toolkit for mobile apps: /flutter-store-ready builds and hardens Flutter apps; /store-review audits before submission; /store-forms drafts Data safety and App Privacy answers; /store-rejection turns an Apple or Google rejection into a fix and a reply. Full automation for Flutter, checklist reviews for native Android/iOS, React Native and Expo.
